WHY IT MATTERS

Turn the feature into a better business process

01

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

Use clients, services & more well

  • Use one canonical record for each customer.
  • Review prices, tax treatment, and stock information when products change.
  • Archive obsolete entries instead of creating near-duplicates.
Always confirm the legal, tax, and record-keeping requirements that apply to your business.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about clients, services & more

Can I save customer details?

Yes. The current site describes saved customer information and customer invoice records.

Can products and services be reused?

The business-record workflow is designed to keep reusable item and service details available.

Does this include legal case management?

No. Invoice Next is presented here as a billing and business-record platform, not a legal case-management system.

Can I review customer billing history?

The existing product messaging includes customer invoice records and payment history.
